title: SETA Evol
input: Existing Harbor tasks accepted by the upstream evolution configuration; prefer its published seeds first.
native_output: Evolved Harbor tasks and lineage/authoring artifacts.

conversion.approach: Keep native task bundles and retain parent identifiers; do not add a new curriculum scheduler.

deviations: Newly generated validated parents; original CHANGE_CONTEXT strategy and Sonnet model.
SDK budget/turn caps; failing baseline parent excluded before generation.
known_limitations: Configured evolution is not a learned scheduler. Keep children separate from originals and preserve the upstream strategy.

why_this_order: Reuse the SETA installation and runtime; change only to its published evolution path.
